hero.title: How can we help?
hero.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about Agent Skills CLI, from installation to skill creation.

cta.title: Still have questions?
cta.body: Check our documentation or open an issue on GitHub

questions.question: How do I install Agent Skills CLI?
questions.answer: Install globally using npm: `npm install -g agent-skills-cli`. After installation, you can use the `skills` command from any directory. Verify installation with `skills --version`.

questions.question: How do I install my first skill?
questions.answer: Run `npx agent-skills-cli install @author/skill-name` to install any skill from the marketplace. For example: `npx agent-skills-cli install @anthropic/xlsx`. The CLI will auto-detect your installed AI agents and install the skill to all of them.

questions.question: How do I search for skills?
questions.answer: Use `skills search <query>` to search the marketplace. For example: `skills search "react components"` or `skills search pdf`. Results show skill name, author, description, and star count.

questions.question: Where are skills installed?
questions.answer: Skills are installed to agent-specific directories: `.cursor/skills/` for Cursor, `.claude/skills/` for Claude Code, `.github/skills/` for Copilot, `.codex/skills/` for Codex, and `.agent/workflows/` for Antigravity.

questions.question: What AI agents are supported?
questions.answer: Agent Skills CLI supports 42+ AI coding agents including: Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, OpenAI Codex, Gemini CLI, Windsurf, Cline, Antigravity, OpenCode, Amp, Continue, Trae, Qwen Code, and 16 more.

questions.question: How do I install to a specific agent?
questions.answer: Use the `-t` or `--target` flag: `npx agent-skills-cli install @author/skill -t cursor` or `npx agent-skills-cli install @author/skill -t cursor,claude` for multiple agents.

questions.question: Does the CLI auto-detect my agents?
questions.answer: Yes! The CLI automatically detects which AI agents are installed in your project by checking for their configuration directories. Run `skills info` to see detected agents.

questions.question: Can I install to all agents at once?
questions.answer: Yes, use the `--all` flag: `npx agent-skills-cli install @author/skill --all`. This installs the skill to every supported agent directory.

questions.question: How do I list installed skills?
questions.answer: Run `skills list` to see all installed skills. Use `skills list --json` for JSON output or `skills list --table` for a formatted table view.

questions.question: How do I check for skill updates?
questions.answer: Run `skills check` to see which installed skills have updates available. The command shows the current and available versions for each skill.

questions.question: How do I update my skills?
questions.answer: Run `skills update` to update all installed skills, or `skills update skill-name` to update a specific skill.

questions.question: How do I uninstall a skill?
questions.answer: Use `skills market-uninstall skill-name` to remove a skill that was installed from the marketplace.

questions.question: How do I create my own skill?
questions.answer: Run `skills init my-skill-name` to create a new skill from a template. This generates a SKILL.md file with the proper structure. Edit this file to add your instructions and examples.

questions.question: What format should skills be in?
questions.answer: Skills are Markdown files (SKILL.md) with YAML frontmatter containing metadata (name, description, author) followed by the skill instructions. See existing skills in the marketplace for examples.

questions.question: How do I publish my skill?
questions.answer: Skills are hosted on GitHub. Create a repository with your SKILL.md file, then submit it to the Agent Skills marketplace for inclusion.

questions.question: The CLI is not finding my skills
questions.answer: Run `skills doctor` to diagnose issues. This checks your installation, agent detection, and skill directories. Use `skills doctor --fix` to automatically repair common problems.

questions.question: Installation failed with permission error
questions.answer: Try installing with sudo: `sudo npm install -g agent-skills-cli`, or use a Node version manager like nvm which doesn't require elevated permissions.

questions.question: Can I disable telemetry?
questions.answer: Yes, set the environment variable `DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1` or `DO_NOT_TRACK=1`. Telemetry is anonymous and only collects command usage statistics, never personal data.
